meeting_point: at the Johnson Entrance to the Boston Public Library on Boylston Street.
accessibility: Mostly flat surfaces and little to no inclines. Stroller and wheelchair accessible
description:
Few are unfamiliar with the famous “Nashville Wings” done by Kelsey Montague. Did you know one of her illustrations is right here in Boston, “Balloons Over Boston/What Lifts You”?

The walk from Copley Square through the South End is full of underappreciated and unknown artwork. On this tour, experience the wonder of the “Betances Mural” to the deeply symbolic work of Pablo Eduardo.

One need not know anything about art, only enjoy beauty in its many forms, to love this tour. “Step on Board” as we discover these hidden gems (bring your camera)!

- 1.2 mile tour at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour
